title: Stamp each stored off-file leftover (each matrix draft, stored document original and Lp(a) kept answer) with the erase it was written under, so a clear removes only what is older than the record's erase
evidence: Was: needs design, not started. The fix the owner named for the A11 limits (US-11 AC6 Limits, after PR 1447). Today one browser key (health_roadmap_cleared_erase) records the erase the whole set was last cleared for, so a clear cannot tell a leftover written after an erase from one written before it. (a) Two tabs: values typed in one tab after an erase are cleared when another tab of this browser takes that erase in late; pinned by packages/health-core/src/record-session.clear-owed.test.ts:486 (describe at :485). (b) Same tab: when this tab's own erase clear and the page's second try both fail to read back, the key stays at the old erase, and values typed in this tab before the next load are cleared at that load (US-11 AC6 Limits). (c) N2: one erase whose clear fails twice sends two 'Record upkeep failed' reports: the session's tryClear (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts:328, called from the erase at packages/health-core/src/record-session-erase.ts:136), then the page's clearOffFileAfterErase (widget-src/src/lib/roadmap-data.ts:101, from HealthTool.tsx:477) through the store's clearOffFileData, which reports with repeat false (widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store.ts:566). Test gap: no test yet drives an own-erase clear failure through the page and checks both reports and a done message with no warning.
